metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins: Skills, Slash Commands, Hooks, and Agents.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: A Codex coding agent based on GPT-5 — a proactive coding collaborator with strong engineering judgment.

plugins.name: pandas-copilot
plugins.description: Use pandas without knowing pandas: provide data (primarily Excel) and a validation standard, and get a verified, repeatable data-processing script or notebook.

plugins.name: otel-dev
plugins.description: Language-agnostic methodology for bootstrapping the OpenTelemetry SDK (providers, exporters, context propagation, resource attributes) and applying semantic conventions correctly

plugins.name: import-linter
plugins.description: Configure, maintain, and diagnose import-linter (Python import architecture enforcement): generate contracts, extend existing configs, and interpret lint-imports failures.

plugins.name: interview-prep
plugins.description: Generate personalized interview questions, interview outlines, follow-up probes, and scoring rubrics from candidate resumes. Built for hiring managers and technical interviewers.
